resources.string: Nothing is read from your phone until you turn a source on. Anything you ask Sentinel to check is sent for analysis only when you choose to.
When Sentinel spots something suspicious, it will show up here with the reasons and what to do next.
Sentinel cannot be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
This device is not signed in to Sentinel yet. Please try again.
Too many requests. Please wait a little and try again.
Sentinel could not complete that request (code %1$d).
Your full alert history will appear here.
Paste a message or share a screenshot to ask whether it is a scam.
Link a family member so they are told about critical alerts.
Choose what Sentinel watches, your language and your privacy options.
